d.ko: Mine, refine, and sell gemstones in Gemporium, a cute, fast-paced shop management game. Upgrade your tools, expand your store, and master the daily rhythm of digging, polishing, and turning a profit to pay off your debt, one gem at a time.
d.en: Mine, refine, and sell gemstones in Gemporium, a cute, fast-paced shop management game. Upgrade your tools, expand your store, and master the daily rhythm of digging, polishing, and turning a profit to pay off your debt, one gem at a time.
d.zh: 《宝石工坊》是一款采矿模拟管理游戏。开采，加工，售卖，将品类丰富的稀有宝石卖给焦急等待的客人。你需要合理分配时间，购买升级项目，不断扩大宝石小店的名气。
